## OKF envelope

```yaml
---
okf_kind: receipts
okf_version: "1.0"
generated_by: "scripts/build-receipts.sh"
generated_at: {YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ}
---
```

## Field contract

Top-level object, one key per evidence category. Each category shares this shape:

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `<category>.value` | varies (number, object) | when `source: measured` | the actual measured result — schema varies by category |
| `<category>.generated_at` | ISO 8601 | yes | when this section was last computed, not when the file was written |
| `<category>.source` | enum: `measured \| absent` | **yes, mandatory** | `absent` when the underlying check couldn't run — never omit the key |
| `<category>.command` | string | yes | the exact runnable command that produced `value` — reproducibility, not decoration |

Known categories today: `compliance` (score %), `golden_suite` (pass_rate/passed/total/commit),
`metrics` (story_count/total_bcps/source_breakdown), `traceability` (total_stories/linked_stories/
total_links). New categories follow the same four-field shape.

## Dashboard mapping

**Compliance/Receipts dashboard view** — one tile per category. **Hard rule:** a category with
`source: absent` renders as a visibly missing/unknown tile (e.g. "not measured"), never blank or
silently dropped — same honesty requirement as `cycle-times.md`'s measured/backfilled rule. The
underlying raw evidence (`specs/verifications/reports/*.md` — timestamped, diagnostic, one per
audit run) stays internal, never published individually; only this aggregate surfaces.
